Filter.PartialJobTooltip: Whether or not an item should be wearable by only the matching job(s) or if it should contain that job.
Filter.Completed.Tooltip: Whether every obtainable piece in the set is owned.
Filter.Incompatible.Tooltip: Whether the set cannot be worn by your character's race and sex.
Filter.Unobtainable.Tooltip: Whether the set cannot currently be obtained.
Filter.Mogstation.Tooltip: Whether the set is obtained from the Mogstation.
Filter.Contributable.Tooltip: Whether an inventory piece can currently be contributed to the set.
Filter.Affordable.Tooltip: Whether you can afford the preferred costs of every missing piece.
Filter.Tradeable.Tooltip: Whether the set has a piece that can be traded or bought on the market board.
Filter.Started.Tooltip: Whether the set is partially completed.
Filter.Armoire.Tooltip: Whether the set contains a piece that can be stored in the armoire.
Filter.Misplaced.Tooltip: Whether an armoire-eligible piece is currently stored in the glamour dresser.
Filter.SharedModel.Tooltip: Whether another set shares the same complete set of equipment models.

AddonFilter.Armoire.HideGearset.Tooltip: When the armoire window is open, all entries that are part of gearsets will be hidden

When the glamour creation window is open, items that can be stored in the armoire are hidden (whether or not you already own them there).
AddonFilter.Dresser.HideNonOutfit.Toolti: When the glamour creation window is open, items that are not part of any outfit set are hidden.
PatchPicker.Footnote: Patches are for when an item was added to the game, not necessarily when it was made available.

Guide.Tweak.Filters: [h]Filters[/h] opens a filter window to hide items that match some criteria:
Guide.Armoire.Title: Armoire
Guide.Armoire.Intro: GlamourLog adds two buttons next to the category arrows on the armoire window.
Guide.Armoire.StoreAll: [h]Store all[/h] stores all eligible items from your inventory into the armoire. Ignores items in gearsets.
Guide.Dresser.Title: Dresser
Guide.Dresser.Intro: GlamourLog adds two buttons above the category arrows on the item deposit window.
Guide.Dresser.StoreAll: [h]Store all[/h] stores all eligible items from your inventory into the dresser. Ignores items in gearsets.
Guide.ChatAlerts.Title: Chat Alerts
Guide.ChatAlerts.Intro: When you loot an item that belongs to a glamour set, outfit progress is appended to the loot notice in chat.
Guide.ChatAlerts.AlreadyOwned: If you already own the item in storage, the loot notice is left unchanged.
Guide.LootWindow.Title: Loot Window
Guide.LootWindow.Intro: When the loot window is open, a badge is displayed on item icons for glam pieces you do not already own.
Guide.LootWindow.Armoire: [h]Armoire badge[/h] is shown on unowned armoire-eligible items.
Guide.LootWindow.Dresser: [h]Dresser badge[/h] is shown on unowned, non-armoire outfit pieces.
Guide.Counters.Title: Counters
Guide.Counters.Completed: The bottom-right of the glamour log displays two numbers. The top number is the amount of sets you have completed out of the total number of sets available in the game.
Guide.Counters.Saved:
The bottom number is the amount of glamour dresser slots you have
saved by having these pieces stored as outfits instead of being loose inside the dresser.
Guide.Counters.FootnoteCombined: Completed counter combines sets in the dresser and the armoire.
Guide.Counters.FootnoteMisc: "Misc Armoire" are not included in either counters.
Guide.Icons.Title: Icons
Guide.Icons.Checkmark: [h]Checkmark[/h] is shown on a set icon when every piece is in your glamour dresser or armoire. Inventory does not count.
Guide.Icons.Unobtainable: [h]Unobtainable[/h] is shown on a set that cannot currently be obtained, e.g. a seasonal event set. These sets are excluded from the completion counters.
Guide.Icons.FadedDresser: [h]Faded Dresser badge[/h] is shown on a complete set or owned piece when the item is in your dresser [e]not[/e] as part of a set.
Guide.Icons.Dresser: [h]Dresser badge[/h] shown on a complete set or owned piece when the item is in your dresser as part of a set.
Guide.Icons.Armoire: [h]Armoire badge[/h] is shown on a complete set or owned piece when the item is in your armoire.
Guide.Icons.WarningDresser: [h]Dresser warning[/h] is shown if the item is currently stored in the dresser but could be stored in the armoire. Also applies to sets.
Guide.Integrations.Title: Plugin Integrations
Guide.Integrations.Intro: GlamourLog does not require other plugins to work, but it can be enhanced with other plugins.
Guide.Integrations.AllaganTools: [e]Allagan Tools[/e] is used in the [h]currencies required[/h] section of [h]set details[/h] to get the amount of currency you have obtained in any inventory on your character. If not installed, this count will default to your standard inventory only.
Guide.Integrations.Vnavmesh: [e]vnavmesh[/e] is used in the context menu of [h]Sources and Costs.[/h] If installed, this context menu entry will navigate you to the relevant source of the item.
Guide.Integrations.AutoDuty: [e]AutoDuty[/e] is used in the context menu of duty [h]Sources.[/h] If installed, this context menu entry will start an AutoDuty loop where your character will run the relevant dungeon until all missing outfit pieces are acquired.
Guide.DataExport.Title: Data Export
Guide.DataExport.Intro: Here you can export your dresser and armoire data into a format importable into websites and other plugins.
Guide.LogWindowSettings.Title: Glamour Log Window
Guide.LogWindowSettings.DisableClose.Too: Prevents the game from closing the addon when you go through an area transition or cutscene. Will still hide the addon. Also disables the ability to close via ESC. Must be clicked manually.
Guide.LogWindowSettings.PersistSearch.To: Keeps the search text when the Glamour Log window is closed and reopened.
